overview_markdown:
AstrBot is a Python 3.12+ AI agent assistant and development framework that connects a wide range of IM platforms (QQ, WeChat, Telegram, Discord, and more) to LLM providers through a unified pipeline. It ships with a web-based management dashboard, a plugin marketplace, knowledge-base/RAG support, and scheduled reminders, making it one of the most feature-complete self-hosted chatbot frameworks available.

Architecturally, it uses an event-driven pipeline with pluggable providers for LLMs, rerankers (e.g., Xinference, TEI), and messaging adapters such as OneBot. Recent commits show active hardening: network policy notices moved into system prompts, file-editing tool escape handling fixes, and rerank failure propagation—evidence of a mature maintenance culture with frequent releases (v4.28.1 as of September 2026).

Compared to OpenClaw, AstrBot trades a lean, security-first footprint for breadth: more IM integrations, a bigger plugin ecosystem, and a friendlier dashboard, but with a heavier Python runtime, AGPL licensing, and less emphasis on sandboxed tool execution. It is best suited for users who prioritize multi-platform reach and extensibility over minimal resource use.
